page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a compute-optimized allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. The instance does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.c8a.48xlarge offers a high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, making it a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads that require predictable CPU performance. This hardware profile is suited for high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, compute-intensive simulations, and distributed compilation workloads.
